title: 第21章 衣锦还乡流水席第22章 区区致命伤也想杀我
content_zh:
出了外事堂，李青山并不如表面这般平静。
一个月前。
他带着族人的期盼，还有一起凑出来的三十多两银子，在堂兄李铁的带领下，入了武馆。
李青山知晓自己有自愈天赋在身，注定能起来。
但也没想过自己会起来的这么快。
如今名录武籍，不说其他优待，单单是手上的千两白银，就是一笔普通人想都不敢想的巨款了。
而这，仅仅是开始。
...
李青山十分好奇自己回去后，族人的反应。
想必一个个，会目瞪口呆吧。
哈哈。
李青山也没空着手回去。
他先是去车行，拿出自己刚刚到手的武人牌籍，租赁了一辆马车和车夫，又让车行的人，帮自己采购了几车的物资。
等临近下午了。
一群人才出了县城，朝石头村的方向赶去。
...
李青山离开后不久。
有消息灵通的，去王孝府邸、还有李青山新领的府院那边拜访，却没见着人，只能带着拉来的礼物离开。
李铁岳父张守拙今日不当值。
他正在附近的茶馆吃着零嘴，听书消磨时光。

见着街道上那间空出来的府院，不时有人上前拜访，茶馆中同样悠闲的人来了兴趣。
周围几条街道的府院，都是铁腿门给武人们歇脚的地方。
这是有新晋的肉身境武者啊。
“给张教习这桌上一盘凤爪。”
一富态中年，朝伙计张罗了一句，随后笑眯眯坐了过来：“张教习，您是八号武馆教习，可知这府院的情况？”
张守拙也在想这事呢。
他摇摇头：“这倒是不知，反正不是我们八号武馆出来的，怎么，王员外是想投资一二？”
富态中年摇摇头：“投资就算了，苦境的生意，不是我这小门小户能碰的，只是家中有女，正是及笄之年，我这当爹的，呵呵。”
边上有人听了，摇摇头：“老王，这么急干嘛，要我看，不如再看看。”
靠着苦境流出来的资源。
县城中，即使只是小富之家，只要肯投入，再耗费时间，慢慢磨，培养出肉身境的族人并不难。
难的是在之后的苦境服役中活下来。
不然真以为铁腿门那么大方，送钱又送房，专门做慈善啊。
其余人听了，皆是点头。
富态中年不以为然，只是将这件事记在了心里。
他们这些人看似过得悠闲，其实是县城里比较尴尬的那一批，上不上，下不下，全靠每一代都养出一两个肉身境顶着。
子女想要联姻那些站稳脚跟的武人，真不容易。
反正他女儿多。
看到机会就将女儿丢出去。
说不定就能碰着个命长一些，能站稳脚跟的肉身境武者。

只要碰到一个，就是赚了。
就这，他都担心对方看不上那点嫁妆，女儿丢不出去呢。
张守拙听着众人讨论，心中更是苦闷。
他儿子不成器。
content_en:
After leaving the Foreign Affairs Hall, Li Qingshan was not as calm as he appeared.
a month ago.
With the expectations of his tribe and more than thirty taels of silver that he had scraped together, he entered the martial arts gym under the leadership of his cousin Li Tie.
Li Qingshan knew that he had the gift of self-healing and was destined to get up.
But I never thought I would wake up so quickly.
Now that he has a military status, not to mention other preferential treatment, just the thousand taels of silver in his hand is a huge sum of money that ordinary people can't even imagine.
And this is just the beginning.
...
Li Qingshan was very curious about the reaction of his tribe after he returned.
Everyone must be stunned.
Ha ha.
Li Qingshan didn't go back empty-handed.
He first went to the car dealership, took out the martial arts license he had just obtained, rented a carriage and driver, and asked the people at the car dealership to help him purchase several carts of supplies.
Wait until it's almost afternoon.
A group of people left the county town and rushed towards Stone Village.
...
Not long after Li Qingshan left.
Someone who was well-informed visited Wang Xiao's residence and Li Qingshan's new residence, but saw no one and could only leave with the gifts they brought.
Li Tie's father-in-law, Zhang Shouzhuo, is not on duty today.
He was eating snacks and listening to books at a nearby teahouse to kill time.
Seeing the vacant mansion on the street, people came to visit from time to time, and the equally leisurely people in the teahouse became interested.
The courtyards in the surrounding streets all have iron-legged gates for warriors to rest.
This is a newly promoted physical realm warrior.
"Give Professor Zhang a plate of chicken feet on this table."
A rich middle-aged man said something to the waiter, and then sat over with a smile: "Zhang Jiaoxi, you are the instructor of the No. 8 martial arts school. Do you know the situation in this courtyard?"
Zhang Shouzhuo was also thinking about this.
He shook his head: "I don't know, it's not from our No. 8 Martial Arts School. Why, Wang Yuanwai wants to invest in it?"
The wealthy middle-aged man shook his head: "Forget it about investing. Business in a difficult situation is not something that a small family like me can touch. It's just that I have a daughter in the family and she is in her prime years. I am a father, haha."
Someone on the side listened and shook his head: "Old Wang, why are you in such a hurry? You want me to see it, why not take another look."
Rely on the resources flowing out of the difficult situation.
In the county, even if it is just a small wealthy family, as long as they are willing to invest, spend time, and slowly grind, it is not difficult to cultivate a clan member in the physical realm.
What was difficult was surviving the difficult service that followed.
Otherwise, I really thought that Iron Leg Door was so generous, giving away money and houses, and doing charity.
The others listened and nodded.
The rich middle-aged man didn't take it seriously and just kept it in mind.
They seem to be living a leisurely life, but in fact they are a relatively embarrassing group in the county. Their ability to move up or down depends entirely on the fact that each generation has raised one or two physical bodies to support them.
It is not easy for children to marry those established warriors.
Anyway, he has many daughters.
Throw your daughter out when you see an opportunity.
Maybe you can meet a physical realm warrior who has a longer life and can gain a firm foothold.
As long as you encounter one, you will make a profit.
At this point, he was worried that the other party would not like the dowry and his daughter would not be able to throw it away.
Zhang Shouzhuo felt even more depressed as he listened to the discussion.
His son is useless.
